text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval on updates to TO Live's financial and Information Technology policies.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved the list of updated policies, as outlined in Attachment 1 to the report (February 3, 2025) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Approved the following updated policies in Attachment 2 to the report (February 3, 2025) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live: a. Finance Policy Number 307 - Travel and Expenses b. Cybersecurity Policy Number 501 - Security Awareness and Training c. Cybersecurity Policy Number 502 - Personal Passwords d. Cybersecurity Policy Number 506 - Access Management
